name: FOLFIRI (Douillard)

biomarkers.note: Cytotoxic FOLFIRI (leucovorin/fluorouracil/irinotecan) backbone is not biomarker-restricted. RAS (KRAS, NRAS), BRAF V600E, HER2 (ERBB2), and MMR or MSI status are tested (broad multigene NGS panel also picks up POLE/POLD1, RET, NTRK) to guide targeted or immunotherapy add-ons, not the backbone itself: anti-EGFR (cetuximab or panitumumab) requires KRAS/NRAS/BRAF wild-type with a left-sided primary; HER2-directed therapy for HER2 amplified; checkpoint inhibitors for dMMR/MSI-H; encorafenib for BRAF V600E. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN, licensed), Colon Cancer Principles of Pathologic and Molecular Review (COL-B) and Principles of Systemic Therapy for Advanced or Metastatic Disease (COL-D).

eligibilityCriteria.source: DeVita, Cancer PPO 12th ed., Table 40.12 footnote

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: normal renal, hepatic, and bone marrow function
eligibilityCriteria.source: DeVita, Cancer PPO 12th ed., Table 40.12 footnote

drugs.name: Irinotecan
drugs.notes: Douillard et al. 2000, DeVita 12th ed. line 123582/123587: 180 mg/m2 IV over 2 hr, day 1 only, concurrently with leucovorin (can be given in same line through Y connector).

drugs.name: Leucovorin
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed. line 123587-123588: 200 mg/m2 IV, concurrently with irinotecan on day 1; days 1 and 2 per source ("all other meds given days 1 and 2").

drugs.name: 5-Fluorouracil (bolus)
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed. line 123588: 400 mg/m2 IV bolus, days 1 and 2, given after irinotecan/leucovorin.

drugs.name: 5-Fluorouracil (infusion)
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed. line 123588: 600 mg/m2 IV infusion over 22 hr, days 1 and 2, given after the 5-FU bolus.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: give before irinotecan per moderate emetic risk tier (appendix D)

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: moderate emetic risk tier (irinotecan IV, 30-90% frequency of emesis per NCCN appendix D categories); specific FOLFIRI per-day tier not printed in the provided appendix excerpt (no per-regimen table included) - verify against full NCCN Antiemesis guideline

G-CSF: febrile neutropenia risk level not printed for FOLFIRI in the provided appendix C excerpt (general risk-tier framework only, no per-regimen table) - commonly categorized intermediate risk in oncology practice; verify against NCCN Hematopoietic Growth Factors guideline before applying
Administration sequence per appendix F: irinotecan and leucovorin given concurrently (same line via Y-connector), followed by 5-FU bolus, followed by 5-FU 22-hr infusion, per source

monitoring: assess for diarrhea (irinotecan-associated) before each cycle

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides.

doseModificationRules.condition: UGT1A1*28 homozygous, hepatic dysfunction, or clinically significant irinotecan-related diarrhea
doseModificationRules.text: DeVita 12th ed. (Chapter 9, irinotecan pharmacology, lines 19427 to 19433): SN-38 is glucuronidated by UGT1A1; deficiency in this pathway increases the risk of diarrhea and myelosuppression, and dose reductions are recommended for patients homozygous for the UGT1A1*28 allele (a genotyping test is available) and for hepatic dysfunction with bilirubin greater than 1.5 (DeVita line 19433). Late diarrhea (onset beyond 24 hr after irinotecan) is managed with loperamide, escalating to diphenoxylate/atropine and opium tincture if severe (lines 19421 to 19426). Note: DeVita Chapter 40 (lines 121523 to 121531) states there are currently no specific guidelines for dose modification on the basis of UGT1A1 polymorphism in routine colorectal-cancer practice, so apply per physician judgement.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

guideline.locator: Colon Cancer, Principles of Systemic Therapy for Advanced or Metastatic Disease (COL-D; FOLFIRI plus/minus bevacizumab as initial/first-line therapy and as subsequent therapy after prior oxaliplatin); Principles of Pathologic and Molecular Review (COL-B)

provenanceNote: Earlier VERIFY-resolution (DeVita core): DeVita 12th ed. places FOLFIRI (Table 40.12) in the section on management of unresectable metastatic disease (header line 123342; unresectable stage IV disease, lines 123351 and 123359) with palliative intent. histology resolved to adenocarcinoma (Chapter 40, line 121516 colorectal adenocarcinoma; Histologic Type section line 121080). treatmentSetting resolved to metastatic and stage to IV from that section. lineOfTherapy resolved to first-line: DeVita states FOLFIRI was initially studied as a salvage regimen but has gained widespread acceptance as a first-line treatment option (lines 123668 to 123670). eligibilityCriteria resolved to good performance status with normal renal, hepatic, and bone marrow function per Table 40.12 footnote (line 123608) and the metastatic-disease entry-criteria preamble (lines 123415 to 123420). An irinotecan UGT1A1 and diarrhea dose-consideration was added to doseModificationRules, sourced to DeVita Chapter 9 (lines 19421 to 19433) with the Chapter 40 routine-practice caveat (lines 121523 to 121531). ONCQIS Wave-1 batch 1 guideline resolution (Standard Guidelines, NCCN licensed, Colon Cancer v2.2026): biomarkers resolved: the cytotoxic FOLFIRI backbone is not biomarker-restricted, while RAS (KRAS, NRAS), BRAF V600E, HER2 (ERBB2), and MMR or MSI status are tested to guide targeted or immunotherapy add-ons (COL-B and COL-D). The guideline concurs with the core metastatic first-line placement and additionally lists FOLFIRI as a subsequent-therapy option after prior oxaliplatin (COL-D); the physician-facing lineOfTherapy is kept as first-line, so no divergence is recorded. No field remains VERIFY. evidence.core evidenceStatus left unknown. No hospital or endorsement claim.
